dct_title_s: A new atlas of the mundane system, or, Of geography and cosmography : describing the heavens and the earth, the distances, motions and magnitudes of the celestial bodies, the various empires, kingoms, states, and republics, throughout the known world : with the particular description of the latest discoveries
dct_description_sm: "The whole elegantly engraved on sixty-four copper plates. With a general introduction to geography and cosmography, in which the elements of these sciences are compendiously deduced from original principles, and traced from thier invention to the latest improvements."

Maps: -- [1] Cosmography epitomised ... -- [2] The Sun -- [3] The principal fixed stars of the Northern Hemisphere ... -- [4] The principal fixed stars of the South Hemisphere ... -- [5] An analemma ... -- [6]  The Solar System -- [7] A map exhibiting the dark shadow of the Moon ... -- [8] Geography. Or description of the Earth -- [9] A new chart of the world ... -- [10] Europe divided into its principal states -- [11] The British Isles ... -- [12] A new and compendious map of England and Wales ... -- [13] Scotland and its islands ... -- [14] Ireland, divided into its four provinces ... -- [15] The Catholic Netherlands, or the Low Countries ... -- [16] The seven united provinces ... -- [17] The northern states ... -- [18] Russia, divided into its governments -- [19] A new map of the Kingdom of Poland ... -- [20] Hungary and Transylvania ... -- [21] The Empire of Germany ... -- [22] Switzerland divided into thirteen cantons ... -- [23] France divided into military governments -- [24] Spain and Portugal ... -- [25] Italy, divided into its states ... -- [26] Italy, comprehending the dominions of the King of Sardinia ... -- [27] First part of Turkey in Europe ... -- [28] Second part of Turkey in Europe ... -- [29] Asia, divided into its principal states and regions ... -- [30] A map of Turkey in Asia ... -- [31] Arabia, according to its modern divisions -- [32] Persia, divided into its great provinces -- [33] A map of independent Tartary ... -- [34] A Compleat map of the East Indies ... -- [35] The East India Islands ... -- [36] China divided into its great provinces ... -- [37] A map of Chinese Tartary with Corea -- [38] A compleat map of the Holy Land ... -- [39] Part II.d of the compleat map of the Holy Land -- [40] A map of the countries and places, mentioned in the New Testament -- [41] Africa and it's [sic] several regions -- [42] Antient and modern Egypt -- [43] A map of Abyssinia and Nubia -- [44] A map of Barbary ... -- [45] America North and South and the West Indies ... -- [46] North America, with the West Indies ... -- [47] A new map of the United States of North America ... -- [48] A compleat map of the West Indies ... -- [49] South America ...
Shirley, R. Maps in the atlases, T. Dun-1
English with some maps in Latin
